rationale: Round 7 confirm, ADR-conformance lens. I read `git diff 8b3a5535 e7388f71` from disk, plus wellFormedGitObjectID at e7388f71. My round-6 ask is ADDRESSED. The diff introduces no ADR-conformance defect. It strengthens the ADR-0042 provenance gate: four value classes, and only well-formed object IDs become git operands, in both F2 and R4.3. A garbage-collected SHA refuses as outside-tip instead of becoming an F5 infra error. The ADR-0041 §2(i) discipline holds on the amended-after-panel refusal: the exit is the dependent's scoped override, and editing the registration is deliberately not offered. The typed ErrPathNotAtRef probe stays outside the ADR-0030 enforcement packages and fails closed on real git errors. The per-checkout visibility limit is stated honestly. Two optional precision notes, neither blocking: class (b) as written can skip a short all-hex value, and the per-checkout limit could be narrowed mechanically.
concrete_changes_required: Optional (precision): R4.2 F2 class (b) 'non-SHA placeholder' is everything that is not option-like, not a revision expression and not wellFormedGitObjectID (7–64 hex). That makes a 4–6-character all-hex value (a valid git abbreviation length) a SKIPPED placeholder rather than an evaluated or fail-closed value. Classify any all-hex value shorter than 7 characters as (d) MALFORMED, so that only non-hex text can be a skipped placeholder.

Optional (narrowing the stated per-checkout limit): when invoked outside the spec worktree, F2 could also scan the spec worktree's `reviews/` at its configured location (cfg.WorktreeRoot/worktree-spec-<S>) when that directory exists, so a reattest or read-back from a bead worktree or main checkout does not silently skip the spec worktree's registrations. If not adopted, keep the current honest output (scanned roots plus run-from-spec-worktree advice).

findings.title: Regression check (git diff 8b3a5535 e7388f71) — ADR lens
findings.detail: ADR-0042: value classes (a) empty skip, (b) placeholder skip+report, (c) wellFormedGitObjectID evaluated, (d) option-like or revision-expression fail-closed; only (c) reaches git, pinned by AC-11 (x-m)/(x-e)/(x-p) with an argv seam. ADR-0041 §2(i): the gc'd SHA (x-g) and amended-after-panel (vii-a) refusals carry the dependent's override exit, and editing the registration is not offered, which is consistent with the panel-edit residual. ADR-0041 §2(ii): unchanged. ADR-0030: the new typed gitutil probe is consumed from internal/next, not an enforcement package. ADR-0037 §8: the per-checkout visibility and untracked reviews/ are stated, not claimed away. The repo-convention evidence is now a re-derivable procedure rather than a count. No defect introduced.

findings.title: Class (b) can skip a short all-hex value
findings.detail: internal/lifecycle/landed.go wellFormedGitObjectID requires 7–64 hex. Per the new class (b) definition, a 4–6-hex value (which git accepts as an abbreviation when unique) is neither (c) nor (d), so it is SKIPPED as a placeholder. It could name an unlanded commit, and F2 would ignore it. The edge is tiny and inside the stated panel-edit residual (agent-writable data), but tightening it costs one clause.
